elements.label: Figure 6.1
elements.title: Machine learning may be used to classify all kinds of data. Facial recognition technology relies heavily on machine learning algorithms, such as random forest models.
elements.details: Photo showing a humanoid robot pointing at a man standing in front of it in a conference or exhibition setting. Background includes display boards and a microphone. Caption credits modification of work 'Humanoid Robot Uprising' by Steve Jurvetson/Flickr, CC BY 2.0.
elements.summary: This image illustrates the application of machine learning in facial recognition technology, highlighting the interaction between humans and AI-powered robots.
